name: Christmas Pudding Cake
subtitle: A fondant-finished fruitcake with festive details
description: Cover a prepared fruitcake with white fondant, then add simple red, green, and gold decorations for a festive dessert.

ingredients.item: red and green food colouring gels

instructions.text: Place the x 20cm fruitcake on a clean work surface and trim or level it as needed for an even finish.
Warm the smooth apricot jam gently until spreadable, then brush it over the top and sides of the cake.
Dust the work surface with icing sugar and roll the ready-to-roll white fondant icing into a sheet large enough to cover the cake.
Lift the fondant over the cake, smooth it over the top and sides, and trim away the excess.
Knead small portions of the ready-to-roll white fondant icing with red and green food colouring gels to create colored decorating fondant.
Shape the colored fondant into simple festive decorations and attach them to the covered cake with a small amount of moisture or jam.
Add edible gold leaf (optional) as a final decoration, then leave the icing set before serving.
